creativeBrief.promise: Keep a private daily record and choose what one partner can see.
creativeBrief.audience: People tracking their cycle and one close partner in global markets
creativeBrief.tone: Existing calm purple and cream Cycle Pair brand, real product UI and readable labels
creativeBrief.logo: Reuse existing two-ring product mark without generating new art
creativeBrief.featureGraphic: Reuse existing 1024x500 Cycle Pair graphic; recheck its text against the final listing
states: sharing with selected fields and preview

previewCapture.origin: actual React Native source rendered in development browser
previewCapture.platformClaims: No physical Android or iPhone capture and no native SDK validation
previewCapture.data: Synthetic emulator actors only; authentication screens excluded
previewCapture.format: PNG RGB without alpha; no device frame, fake OS chrome, marketing overlay or resampling
previewCapture.evidence: Capture run, candidate SHA, source and fixture hashes, per-file dimensions and SHA256 in the external capture manifest

finalUpload.legacyImages: Existing phone and tablet assets show an earlier UI and must not be accepted as current candidate evidence
finalUpload.apple: iPhone only; no iPad or Watch slot. Verify current iOS appearance before replacing upload slots; screenshot-size compliance does not prove iPhone origin.
finalUpload.play: Four current phone scenes per locale prepared first; old tablet images need current platform capture if those slots remain in use.
finalUpload.localeMapping: Do not upload the same Korean screenshots for en-US. The current uploader has a flat asset list, so use an explicitly reviewed locale-specific input or Console mapping.
